decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-23 MODIFY recording the same ~1.65x minimum DSCR target together with the other availability-payment sizing rules.
The DSCR sizing target does not change the required Case F versus Case G comparison or the identification of availability payment as the PPP payment mechanism.
The new DSCR target informs payment sizing but does not alter the existing requirement to demonstrate that availability-style payments are necessary for viability and bankability.
The source change establishes a DSCR target, while this candidate's message-23 Event already records the independently stated equity IRR output and target range.
The minimum DSCR target does not change the separately specified 55/45 debt-equity structure, approximate interest rate, or mezzanine treatment.
The availability-payment DSCR target does not modify the required CCA classes, depreciation treatment, or tax-shield modeling.
The DSCR target does not alter the independently selected CAD 48–64M annual operating-cost basis or its full-network scope.
The coverage target does not change the twelve-site network structure or the Business Case site list selected elsewhere in the source message.
The minimum DSCR target has no necessary effect on the model's AUD currency basis, 2031 price base, or the separate unresolved CAD opex conversion issue.
The DSCR target does not alter the separately required program-wide cost categories or their presentation as capex line items.
The source's numerical coverage target does not change the candidate's general data, formula, linkage, error-correction, or quality-review obligations.
The confirmed DSCR target is a model input decision but does not modify the existing requirement to disclose assumptions and trace them to authorized references.
